features.sectionSubtitle: TripGenie solves the hardest parts of independent travel: shorter daily routes, transparent budgets, and effortless group collaboration.

route.title: No more crisscrossing the city. Stops grouped along the shortest path.
route.description: Skip hours of cross-checking maps to see which eateries sit near Linh Ung Pagoda or Dragon Bridge. TripGenie clusters nearby spots and sequences your day cleanly — saving an average of 45 minutes of transit every day.
route.bullet1: Automatically clusters eateries & landmarks along the same corridor
route.bullet2: Flags peak traffic windows and recommends the best visiting hours
route.bullet3: Drag and drop stops to match your natural pace
route.daNangTitle: Son Tra Peninsula — My Khe Beach, Da Nang
route.phuQuocTitle: Sao Beach — Ham Ninh Fishing Village, Phu Quoc
route.daNangLeg1: 3.8 km • ~12 min by motorbike or taxi
route.daNangStop2Title: 09:30 — Son Tra Peninsula & Linh Ung Pagoda
route.daNangStop2Sub: 67m Lady Buddha overlooking the East Sea
route.daNangLeg2: 6.2 km • Breezy Hoang Sa coastal road
route.daNangStop3Sub: My Khe Beach — Garlic butter prawns & steamed squid
route.phuQuocLeg1: 14 km • Open straight highway to South Island
route.phuQuocStop2Sub: Powdery white sand & crystal turquoise water
route.phuQuocStop3Sub: Fresh Ham Ninh blue crab & sunset views
route.switchToDaNang: Switch back to Da Nang route

budget.title: Know every cost upfront. Split group expenses clearly and fairly.
budget.description: No awkward money math after the trip ends. TripGenie tracks real ticket prices and local dining averages, then splits shared costs automatically across every traveler in your group.
budget.bullet1: Verified pricing from local eateries and attractions
budget.bullet2: Automatic per-person split, fair and transparent
budget.bullet3: No hidden surprises — stay in control before departure
budget.footnote: *Automatically separates shared group costs from personal spending.

collab.title: Plan together with one link. No more chaotic group chats.
collab.description: Say goodbye to buried messages and mismatched screenshots. Share one link so everyone can pin favorite cafes, vote on dinner spots, and watch the itinerary update live.
collab.bullet1: Invite friends instantly via a single link or QR code
collab.bullet2: Built-in voting so the group picks restaurants democratically
collab.bullet3: Synced instantly across phone, tablet, and laptop
collab.cardTitle: Day 2 dinner vote in Da Nang
collab.item1Sub: Suggested by Minh Huy & Lan Anh
collab.item2Title: Be Thui Cau Mong Muoi Hien
collab.hint: Click a restaurant to try interactive group voting

editorial.title: Eat where locals go, catch the best views
editorial.description: Curated by TripGenie's local team — zero tourist traps, zero clutter, letting authentic Vietnam shine.

da-nang.subtitle: Central Vietnam • 7 local heritage eateries
da-nang.title: Da Nang Food Map: Mi Quang, Be Man Seafood & Sau Lien Dessert
da-nang.description: Savor steaming shrimp-and-pork Mi Quang at 95 Nguyen Tri Phuong, fresh catch along My Khe Beach, and rich durian sweet soup.

ha-noi.subtitle: Thousand-year capital • 36 Old Quarter streets
ha-noi.title: Hanoi: Hidden Alleys, Giang Egg Coffee & Charcoal Bun Cha
ha-noi.description: Stroll Hoan Kiem Lake at dawn, sip velvety Giang egg coffee, and enjoy smoky bamboo-skewered Bun Cha.

phu-quoc.subtitle: Kien Giang • Sao Beach & May Rut Islet
phu-quoc.title: Phu Quoc: Sao Beach, Bun Quay & Ham Ninh Sunset
phu-quoc.description: Snorkel southern coral reefs, stir your own bowl of Kien Xay Bun Quay, and watch a crimson sunset at Ham Ninh fishing village.

hoi-an.subtitle: Quang Nam • Nostalgic Ancient Town
hoi-an.title: Hoi An: Lantern Streets, Banh Mi Phuong & Mot Herbal Tea
hoi-an.description: Drift lanterns down the Hoai River, taste chewy Cao Lau noodles, and bite into a loaded Banh Mi Phuong.

sa-pa.subtitle: Lao Cai • Majestic Northwest
sa-pa.title: Sa Pa: Cloud Hunting at O Quy Ho Pass & Salmon Hotpot
sa-pa.description: Chase sunset clouds atop O Quy Ho Pass, wander Ta Van village through terraced valleys, and warm up with sour bamboo salmon hotpot.
